Normalize ◦ Scales the grid cell value for each feature to a value such that the minimum value for that layer is 0 and the maximum value is 1 3. Site Suitability ◦ Computes a site suitability score for each grid based on a user-specified weighted-criteria model of normalized characterization values – Can be computed through a random forest model if final feature set is available 4. Spatial Downscaling ◦ Downscales user-input projections of large load growth to grid cells, based on site suitability and other user-specified settings and constraints. Stacked, unified grid of characterizations used in following steps National Laboratory of the Rockies | 8 Characterize Operations Characterize Operations Operation Description Input Layer feature count Counts the number of instances of the input feature within the grid vector Computes a sum for a numeric attribute from the input feature for all the instances of the input feature within the sum attribute grid vector sum length Computes the length of the input feature within the grid (e.g.,length of distribution lines within grid) vector Computes the attribute length of the input feature within the grid. Attribute length is defined as the product of sum attribute length the length and numeric attribute from the input feature. vector sum area Computes the sum of the area of the input feature with the grid (e.g.,total area of wetlands with grid) vector percent covered Computes the area of the grid covered by the input feature vector area-weighted average Computes the area-weighted average of a numeric attribute from input features intersecting each grid cell vector Computes the area-apportioned sum of a numeric attribute from input features within each grid cell. Area- apportioning for each feature works by determining the proportion of each feature within a given grid, as a function of its intersecting area divided by its total area. The attribute value of the feature is then multiplied by this proportion to "apportion" the value to the zone (e.g.,computing the cost of fresh water in each grid from area-apportioned sum REEDS thermal cooling supply curves). vector Computes the area-weighted majority of a categorical input feature (i.e., selects the category from instances of area-weighted majority the input feature that make up the largest area within the grid) vector
